summary: Non-Invasive Monitoring Systems filed an 8-K disclosing that on August 17, 2026, merger target Gravitics, Inc. signed a $1,000,000 unsecured bridge loan with BZH SPO LLC, funded August 18. NIMS guaranteed the note, effective only upon closing of the reverse takeover in which Gravitics Merger Sub merges into Gravitics, making it a wholly owned NIMS subsidiary. The note matures in 60 days, bears 4.0% per 30-day period plus 50% original issue discount per period and a 3.0% default premium post-day-60, repaid from the concurrent public offering's proceeds. Watch financing and closing risk.
